venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: Strong start to Tuesday — HH for 40 people from 5pm to 7pm; opening bartender + MOD handled flow well. Each event introduces new people to the space (lead with curiosity and connection). Crowd stayed steady; around 7pm Bingo regulars arrived. HH guests didn't all leave until 8pm and they extended their tab — clearly enjoyed themselves. Few regulars came in late and big pop around 11pm; smooth last call. Beat target by +28.9% ($2,593 vs $2,011). Food $80 (slow kitchen day after the event). Event sales $1,500. Comps very low at $3.20. 38 guests / $68.25 GCA. 86: sprite, cider; low: night-on-Ponce favorite moment, rosé. MOD: MKZ/JK. Entered by Mya. Highlight: a few event guests returned for a nightcap.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.weather: Warm and overcast/rainy with thunderstorms predicted
venues.narrative: Relatively sleepy night — guests mentioned wanting to beat the storms home. Service volume peaked 7-7:30pm with bingo arrivals (including a group of coworkers from upstairs). Expected lull after bingo and did not see usual late-night traffic. Missed target by −27.9% ($1,359 vs $1,886). Food $17 (5th consecutive day of food <$130 — soft food sales remain a persistent flag). Comps $84.10 / 6.2% (manager comp + industry). 42 guests / $32.37 GCA. 86: candied ginger, candied papaya, sarsaparilla soda. MOD: MD. Entered by BC. Highlight: bingo regulars returned about an hour later to celebrate a birthday — nice to see familiar event-related faces outside of their usual appearance.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: Tuesday with a good first-half pop into a calm finish. DC/AM: few IRDs and deep cleaning. D&C PM: not slow enough to make aggressive cuts but quieter than typical Tuesdays — fun shift; two guests stayed 6.5 hours (longest seen). Net sales (excl events) $6,232.29 vs target $6,992.70 (−10.9%). Including events $9,174.29 (+31.2% vs target). Segments: DC/AM $705.94, D&C PM $5,526.35, 6A NA. Comps $397 / 6.37%. 156 guests. Food $1,201 / Food incl events $3,922. **Event**: Day 1 of Omada Health meetings — 19 guests in Vauxhall 8am-5pm, Josh executed breakfast & lunch buffets ($2,721 event food / $2,942 net event sales). Day 2 tomorrow. AM MOD: Maggie & Lucas. PM MOD: Carey. Kitchen: Antonio and Marv. Break make-up complete. Highlight: a goofball family came in close to last call and livened the team back up — Reagan kept them contained and laughing.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: Quick first push around 6/6:30pm; remained steady through the night, dying down around 11pm — then a big crowd of industry friends came through to bid farewell to Courtney (her last night). Top seller: Masari (13). James handled bar guests exquisitely; Kyler and Marielle rocked service. Welcomed members and folks from Gramercy Tavern and Bar Bianchi. Door (SH): handful of resys + several walk-ins had room 80% full by 6:30; lots of 1's. Plug-and-plays w/ several 'out by's saw a minimal waitlist; by 9:30pm room fully sat except one large table. Serious drop-off post-10:15 — temp drop killed earlier foot traffic; Knicks game may have had small impact. Industry friends from El Camino and Bateman's came post-11pm. **No-shows**: William Langfitt (2), Tomer Bar (4) — not charged. Food $394; Bev $3,367. Net $3,895 vs target $4,235 (−8.0%). Comps $151 (industry + Court's friends). 98 covers est from check avg ($32) — typeform reported guest count omitted, ~122 inferred. Glassware: one candle broken (RIP). MOD: Cara + Steeves. Entered by Marielle. Highlight: industry farewell celebration for Courtney.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: A night that showed the team's true colors — collaborative and adaptable Swiss-army-knife mode. One server wasn't feeling well: Ruffy stepped up to barback, Alissa to serve, Natalie to host. Mitchell was in for floor training and did fantastic. Steady pace all evening — never overwhelming, never super slow — perfect for learning and connecting with guests. Quite a few first-timers and larger groups toward end of night; nearly every table ordered food (snack or two). Saw a few luxury pours go out. Closed strong with a 10-top, 6-top, and 4-top getting close to $5K. Beat target by +11.3% ($4,900 vs $4,402). All from Marquee (SR $0). Food $987 — *nearly $1K on a Tuesday* — kitchen sold lots of shrimp toast, cookies, and french fries (defrosted more shrimp toast mid-shift). Comps $51 (Alissa food comp, birthday, investor, Raven's food). 122 guests / $40.17 GCA. 86: Yamazaki 12yr. **Maintenance/smell update**: smell being masked very well with odor absorbers (Chef's idea) — placed near vents in SR, hallway, and Marquee, none in guest view. Note: this is mitigation, not resolution — underlying plumbing/HVAC inspection still recommended. MOD: Gigi & Vic. Entered by Gigi. Highlight: a table's faces when they asked for coasters and got little sandwich baggies with sets of 4 in each.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: Solid Tuesday at the 124. Steady throughout the night with seatings alternating between floor and bar. Convention guests definitely drove walk-in traffic (108 total: 26 booked / 82 walk-in). Team worked together well; natural last call with last guests departing a few minutes after midnight. Beat target by +68.0% ($5,615.77 net incl events vs $3,342). Marquee bar $3,825.77. **Event** in the Garden: $1,790 (private event went very smoothly). Food $463.30 (12.1%). Comps very low: $23.26 / 0.6% (community member). Voids none flagged. GCA $35.42 / CA $91.02. **Maintenance**: hot water heaters awaiting parts; **Kitchen AC technician on site tomorrow 4/29**; bathroom OOO awaiting part info (no progress on bathroom flagged for many days). MOD: Kevin. Entered by Kevin. What went well: guest connections, communication, event execution. Improve: continue ABK during busy times. Highlight: familiar faces bringing in others to celebrate birthdays — DC being recommended.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: Slow start to the night, with most action from 6pm onward; folks cleared out before 11pm. Morning saw a small pop around 12pm with Berry and Sofia continuing training. A French TV film crew toured and filmed in the space — the team kept everything well knolled. Patio benefited from great weather. Evening: very slow start with the majority of action from 6pm on; no support staff scheduled but everyone worked cohesively. Sun Club steady with Sofia’s first day of training. Hot Eye closed. Net $4,451 vs target $7,600 (−41.4%). Food $2,128. Comps $431. Sales mix: AM bar $720, PM bar $3,387, Sun Club $336. Morning MOD: Gabby. Evening MOD: James + Sukru. Entered by James. Highlight: Eryn stepping up to support Matt behind the bar; Mashama Bailey came in for a burger and martinis and loved the experience. Maintenance: dish-sink spray handle gasket leak — work order submitted, handle removed for end of shift.
